apiFacts.actorThreading: mineOre, manufacture, transferWarehouseToPort, transferPortToWarehouse, loadCargo, unloadCargo, prepareVessel and exitVessel accept an optional trailing actor defaulting to system.
apiFacts.appAttribution: Authenticated Player routes pass the Player URI; entry and departure pass the verified Registry sender and never fabricate a Player.
apiFacts.varietyPortPolicy: Optional local Policy map keyed by canonical FCTP Variety URI; missing means allow; deny rejects load/unload before mutation with an actor-attributed audit entry.
apiFacts.policyValidation: The app accepts only a record of safe absolute http/https URI keys without credentials and allow/deny values.
apiFacts.previews: Action discovery still runs on cloned state with the default system actor and does not persist audit.

limits: The Variety permit is a local Territory A administrative policy, not an FCTP field.
Territory B does not implement the same permit mechanism in this unit.
No active-visit cargo request still fails at the adapter authorization layer without a domain audit entry.
